description: Melbourne Bike Share Station Readings 2011-2017 is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne open data portal (data.melbourne.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This dataset show the historical Melbourne Bike Share dock usage. This program came to an end in November 2019. This dataset contains the historical dock readings from sensors in Melbourne's Bike Share. Melbourne Bike Share is a joint RACV/Victorian Government bicycle hire scheme. Coverage: City of Melbourne, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. Its tags are bike, historical, share, time, Transport. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2020-05-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
